KaTeX — vendored assets for the Anchor R&D report viewer (Reader mode)
======================================================================

Purpose
-------
The Anchor report viewer's "Reader" mode renders an effort's `report.md` as HTML
and uses KaTeX to typeset LaTeX math. These assets are VENDORED (committed into
the repo) so the Reader needs NO install and NO network access at runtime — the
served HTML links these local files under `vendor/katex/`, never a CDN.

Version
-------
KaTeX 0.16.11

Source (official jsdelivr CDN mirror of the npm package `katex@0.16.11`)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  katex.min.css       https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/katex.min.css
  katex.min.js        https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/katex.min.js
  auto-render.min.js  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js

Downloaded 2026-06-08. The files in this directory are the REAL, unmodified
KaTeX 0.16.11 distribution files (verified: katex.min.css opens with the
`@font-face` KaTeX_AMS declaration; the JS files are the genuine UMD bundles).

Fonts (optional add — deliberately omitted from the byte-present vendor set)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
`katex.min.css` references its WOFF2/WOFF/TTF web fonts via relative URLs under
`fonts/` (e.g. `fonts/KaTeX_Main-Regular.woff2`). The full font set is ~1 MB of
binary WOFF2 files. To keep the vendored payload light, the font BINARIES are
NOT committed here; the `fonts/` directory is created as the documented drop
location. Math still renders structurally without the fonts (the browser
substitutes a system font); for pixel-perfect glyphs, drop the font binaries
into `vendor/katex/fonts/` (the CSS already points there — no edit needed).

The testable invariant for the report viewer is that the Reader correctly
REFERENCES these vendored assets (the `vendor/katex/` CSS + JS + an auto-render
call) and renders the markdown — NOT that the font binaries are byte-present.

Re-fetching everything (CSS + JS + the full font set)
-----------------------------------------------------
Run `fetch_katex.sh` (bash + curl) in this directory, or manually:

  V=0.16.11
  base=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@$V/dist
  curl -sLo katex.min.css        $base/katex.min.css
  curl -sLo katex.min.js         $base/katex.min.js
  curl -sLo auto-render.min.js   $base/contrib/auto-render.min.js
  # Optional fonts (pixel-perfect glyphs):
  for f in AMS-Regular Caligraphic-Bold Caligraphic-Regular Fraktur-Bold \
           Fraktur-Regular Main-Bold Main-BoldItalic Main-Italic Main-Regular \
           Math-BoldItalic Math-Italic SansSerif-Bold SansSerif-Italic \
           SansSerif-Regular Script-Regular Size1-Regular Size2-Regular \
           Size3-Regular Size4-Regular Typewriter-Regular; do
    curl -sLo fonts/KaTeX_$f.woff2 $base/fonts/KaTeX_$f.woff2
  done
